title_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 5)
description_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 5), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: A detailed discussion concerning anthropomorphic viewpoints held by Ibn Taymiyya and his school.
